info.title: fitai.coach Workout API
info.description:
API for managing workouts, exercises, and training plans.

### Coverage
This document is generated from the Zod schemas in `shared/openapi.ts` and
the path modules in `shared/openapiRoutes/`, and describes every client route
under `/api/v1`. `test/docs/openapiCoverage.test.ts` keeps it that way: a
new route fails CI until it is registered. Webhooks, unsubscribe links, health
probes and operator endpoints are left out on purpose; that test lists each
with its reason.

### Errors
Errors use `ErrorResponse` (`{ error, code, details? }`), except validation
failures from the Zod middleware, which use `ValidationErrorResponse`
(`{ code: "VALIDATION_ERROR", message, details.issues }`). `code` is a member
of the ErrorCode catalogue in `server/errors.ts`.

### Native app
The mobile app sends `X-App-Platform` and `X-App-Version` on every request;
a build below the server's minimum gets `426` with `AppUpdateRequiredResponse`.
Bearer-authenticated requests need no CSRF token.

### Authentication
This API is protected using JWT Bearer authentication provided by Clerk.
To authenticate your requests:
1. Obtain a valid JWT session token for your user from Clerk. If you are building a frontend integration, you can use Clerk's `getToken()` method from their SDKs.
2. Include the token in the `Authorization` header of your HTTP requests as follows:
   `Authorization: Bearer <your-clerk-jwt-token>`

Click the **Authorize** button below to enter your JWT token for use within this Swagger UI.

ChatStreamEvent.description: One Server-Sent Event of the coach chat stream, sent as a `data: <json>` line followed by a blank line. Each event carries exactly one of these keys (error may come with reason), in this order: ragInfo, the first event of every stream; safetyNotice, only when the athlete's words matched the safety patterns, to show above the reply; status and text events as the reply is written; planProposal, at most once after the text, the plan change the coach drafted (status applied when the athlete's auto-apply setting already applied it); factProposal, at most once and only on a turn sent with userMessageId/assistantMessageId, a fact offered for the athlete card (status pending), answered with POST /api/v1/chat/messages/{assistantMessageId}/fact; and last done or error. A client that disconnects gets no closing event.

Send userMessageId and assistantMessageId (new UUIDs) and the server owns the conversation: it reads the history from the database, ignores `history`, and saves both turns under those ids. A retry sends the same userMessageId and names the failed reply in replaceAssistantId. Without the ids nothing is saved (the old client path). The athlete's turn is saved before the first event; the reply, finished or cut off, when the stream ends. A message classified as a plan change (planEditing on) is answered with a plan proposal. Refusals before the stream starts are ordinary JSON errors; once it has started, failures arrive as a closing error event. The stream is cut at 5 minutes. Rate limited to 10/min; the body may be up to 5 MB (one photo).
